ruling.citation: Tom-ruled 2026-08-27, CAMPAIGN_LOG 27gm: 'HYDROGEN ARMS: QUARANTINE (not remove, not keep): loud ValueError guards at the H entry points of cablp/atomic/ per the D3/surrogate idiom, naming the unsupported domain and the known-corrupt H table (sbq:L295); code and tables stay for a future validated re-opening. Numerics-inert (zero solver-path consumers).'
ruling.expansion: QUARANTINE is the middle disposition between the two the ruling explicitly rejects. Removal was rejected because the arms may be re-opened on a validated basis; keeping was rejected because a silently-computing untested arm with a known-corrupt table is a fabrication hazard. The guards convert every H route from silently-computing to refused.
ruling.closes: The R0.5 deferred supported-domain question, per the same log entry.

the_corrupt_table.located_in_tree_at: cablp/atomic/cross_sections.py -- A_R318, row index 1. The record's pre-R2 path '_cross.py:469-479' resolves to this file after the R2 carve (tag r2-tip-2026-08-27).
the_corrupt_table.physics: H + H+ charge-exchange rate coefficient, IAEA heavy-particle 2-D log-log polynomial fit.
the_corrupt_table.defect: Row 1 repeats the coefficient 9.536923957409e-03 on two consecutive lines, giving that row 10 entries.
the_corrupt_table.why_it_is_silent: heavy_reaction iterates 'for j in range(len(A[i]))', so a ragged row contributes an EXTRA polynomial term rather than raising. The module-level '_cx_H = heavy_reaction(temps, 0.1, A_R318)' is therefore built at import time without complaint, and any H charge-exchange rate read from it is wrong by an unquantified amount.
the_corrupt_table.helium_unaffected: A_R531 (He + He+) is a clean 9x9 and was never touched by this defect. This is the 'He-inert' half of the board row, now independently re-verified.
the_corrupt_table.disposition: NOT FIXED by this member, deliberately. The record requires the row be digit-proofed against IAEA HYDHEL 3.1.8 ON FETCH; that fetch has not happened, and guessing which of the two lines to delete is exactly the fabrication the quarantine exists to prevent. The guard names the defect and the required source so the re-opener cannot miss it.
